title: ANSI TCAP: Fix some copy and paste issues
description:
The number of digits doesn't need a value string; this is for the BCD
digits itself (that could be retrieved a different way.) The value
string currently used for the digits is wrong.

"Gap" is copied from a different field and used for many of the digits;
many of those also have the wrong filter abbreviation.
I have seen "numbering plan" and "number plan" but never "number
planning". Fix an off by one where a loop should use a strict
inequality. Get rid of a "\n" that won't show up in an expert blurb
(we enforce a single line nowadays.)

Use the hf for the entire parameter set that wasn't being used; set its
length after we know it.
